notes: Getting stronger now pays: a personal record is worth 100 XP, up from 20, so a PR session always beats an identical session without one.
Sets past a muscle group's MRV now earn about half XP, so junk volume is no longer the cheapest XP in the game.
Titles arrive sooner: Rookie to Trainee now lands at level 3, and each title after it steps three levels apart instead of five.
Every session now shows the XP it earned with its multiplier, like '+180 XP (x1.5)', and tapping it opens the breakdown of where the XP came from.
